items.title: Hong Leong Assurance Reprices Medical Premiums By 9% Annually Until 2028, One-Year Deferment For 60-Somethings
items.summary: Hong Leong Assurance's 2026 medical repricing involves 9% annual premium increases for 3 years (Nov 2026, Nov 2027, Nov 2028), and projected hikes at 11% in Nov 2029 and 12% in Nov 2030: cumulative 50% hike in 5 years. Certain seniors get 1-year deferment. The post Hong Leong Assurance Reprices Medical Premiums By 9% Annually Until 2028, One-Year Deferment For 60-Somethings appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Pulai MP Reveals Cashless Facilities Revoked From 190 Specialists Nationwide
items.summary: Pulai MP Suhaizan says 190 private specialists nationwide have lost cashless facilities, warning that patients may face treatment delays and hefty upfront costs. Kuala Kangsar MP Iskandar slams insurers’ one-year waiting period for new specialist doctors. The post Pulai MP Reveals Cashless Facilities Revoked From 190 Specialists Nationwide appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Higher Valency Pneumococcal Vaccines Need Stronger Local Evidence: Experts
items.summary: Malaysia should assess whether higher valency pneumococcal vaccines offer enough added protection to justify their higher cost. Experts say vaccine choice should be guided by local disease patterns, stronger surveillance, and cost-effectiveness. The post Higher Valency Pneumococcal Vaccines Need Stronger Local Evidence: Experts appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: ‘Health, Harapan And Healing Malaysia’ Absolves PH Of Bad Policies
items.summary: Dr Sean Thum’s book offers little insight into health policies in Malaysia, containing mostly motherhood statements instead and some surprisingly basic errors. The author’s reluctance to call out Pakatan Harapan or take a decisive stance on issues is notable. items.title: Kuala Langat MP Demands Equal Compensation For Five FDS Victims
items.summary: Kuala Langat MP Ahmad Yunus calls for equal compensation for the families of all five victims of the Long Lellang tragedy, saying it was disappointing that this wasn't announced in Budget 2027. MOH announced RM130,000 payouts to families of its four staff. The post Kuala Langat MP Demands Equal Compensation For Five FDS Victims appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: MCTC Claims Possible Government Attempt To Delist Liquid Nicotine Again
items.summary: MCTC says the government is possibly renewing its attempt to exempt liquid nicotine from the Poisons List by returning to the Poisons Board, after the High Court nullified the 2023 exemption. MCTC urges the Board to again reject any proposed exemption. The post MCTC Claims Possible Government Attempt To Delist Liquid Nicotine Again appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Overcrowding In Emergency Departments, Ward Bed Shortages In Government Hospitals — Assistant Medical Officer
items.summary: Malaysia doesn't need to directly "import" foreign experts to manage the local system. Instead, adapting proven international modules while providing sufficient space, authority, and funding for local public health experts to execute reforms is sufficient. items.title: When Perak’s Trauma Centre Has No C-Arm — Specialist
items.summary: C-arm is essential imaging equipment that allows surgeons to see bones and implants in real time during many fracture fixation procedures. When this equipment became unavailable at HRPB, cases had to be diverted to other hospitals in the state. The post When Perak’s Trauma Centre Has No C-Arm — Specialist appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Sarawak Presents RM500,000 Aid To Five FDS Victims’ Families
items.summary: At a Kuching ceremony, Sarawak Premier Abang Jo presents RM100,000 cheques to each family of 5 victims killed in the Long Lellang tragedy, besides education sponsorships for their kids. One of the widows, Stephanie, says Sarawak helped a lot from Day One. The post Sarawak Presents RM500,000 Aid To Five FDS Victims’ Families appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Revert To Pre-2016 For True ‘Abolition’ Of Contract Doctor System
items.summary: To truly “abolish” the contract doctor system, all medical graduates entering housemanship in 2027 should be automatically made permanent staff on Day One of training — reverting back to pre-2016 — so that 2026 will mark the last contract doctor cohorts.
